start_skill.invocation: Execute steerline-start-task for the exact already-claimed task using the supplied dispatch context, then continue with steerline-finish-task in the same execution.

finish_skill.invocation: After implementation and required validation pass, execute steerline-finish-task to commit, publish and verify this task's PR and return the structured handoff.

workflow: Start implements Spec plus Plan and verifies acceptance; finish publishes and returns the PR. Leave Beads in_progress. Post-merge completion belongs exclusively to the configured completion command.
